programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,第一批長有眼睛的動物無法分辨顏色—但隨著情況改變,無論是尋找食物、吸引配偶還是警告敵人,「看見色彩」令動物擁有很多優勢。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #2
programme.desc: 大衛艾登堡揭示大自然中一些最狡猾的騙子和偽裝大師。發掘一些動物如何使用顏色隱藏並消失在背景中,或是耍詭計和欺騙。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #9
programme.desc: 信不信由你,在波斯尼亞戰爭期間,有超過70,000名波斯尼亞人移民至聖路易。縱使他們熱愛他們的新國家,但也帶來了一些美國人認為有些奇怪的習俗,然而他們的食物卻非常美味。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #10
programme.desc: 在多年的殖民統治中,美國從定居的移民那裡鑽研他們的食物。現在有一種叫做「美國」的美食,十分好吃。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #11
programme.desc: 發掘一種文化的根源總是很有趣。我們追蹤非裔美國人在美麗的新奧爾良定居的歷史。

programme.title: 美國道地料理大搜查 #12
programme.desc: 這種移動趨勢正席捲各州,同時將食物帶給人們。我們跟上大隊,並品嚐美食。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #1
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔嘗試找出一個古老戰士部落神秘消失的原因,並揭露維京人、巨人和尼斯湖水怪的傳奇故事。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #2
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔探索一幅神秘的巨型山丘畫,並被古代神話、當地的民間傳說和異教徒儀式所吸引。是誰出於甚麼原因把它放在那裡?

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #2
programme.desc: 在冰島,邦妮與雙胞胎展開史詩冒險——賞鯨、火山健行、策馬奔馳,還有極光下的深度環保對話。

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #3
programme.desc: 在杜拜,路克全力挑戰腎上腺素極限: 潛水探險、水上飛行器、揮桿高爾夫、快艇狂飆——最後邊晚餐邊暢聊《哈利波特》回憶,輸家買單!

programme.title: 朋友與他們的產地 #4
programme.desc: 在波蘭,蘇菲拋下寧靜假期,換來滿滿刺激: 征服壯麗塔特拉山、漂流急湍河道、探訪傳奇鹽礦,精彩不間斷!

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #3
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔前往奧克尼群島,進入傳說中的巨怪巢穴,以調查一宗維京人寶藏、慾望和瘋狂案件。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #4
programme.desc: 德魯伊是史前嬉皮士還是嗜血的人類祭獻怪醫?克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔探索安格爾西島,研究人食人,並面對熾熱的柳條人。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #5
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和人類學家瑪麗安奧喬塔「回到」34,000年前,調查一副神秘的紅骨,並捲入長毛象和喪屍的狩獵中。

programme.title: 神秘的英國 2 #6
programme.desc: 克萊夫安德森和瑪麗安奧喬塔找尋傳奇的不列顛國王。克萊夫遇到真正的梅林,並試圖揮舞王者之劍,而瑪麗安在圓桌會議列席,並尋找亞瑟的安息之地,以揭露傳說背後的真相。

programme.title: 巨型長毛象的足跡
programme.desc: 這具百萬年歷史的巨大杜爾福��毛象骨骸,急需進行世界首創的緊急修復。我們跟隨這個艱钜的拆卸和重組脆弱化石的過程。透過電腦成像技術(CGI)和博物館知識,這部影片讓這個引人入勝卻鮮為人知的巨型生物重獲「生命」。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #3
programme.desc: 找出對動物顏色的科學研究背後的故事—從機械青蛙到現實世界對應物種間的角力,到蜘蛛畫眼線來吸引配偶。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #1
programme.desc: 春天來臨。北約克沼澤國家公園裡的動物必須尋找食物、配偶,並組織家庭。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #2
programme.desc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方麅和她的雙胞胎。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 約克郡 #3
programme.desc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方麅們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備。至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睾酮的氣息。

programme.title: 大衛艾登堡: 自然本色 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,第一批長有眼睛的動物無法分辨顏色—但隨著情況改變,無論是尋找食物、吸引配偶還是警告敵人,「看見色彩」令動物擁有很多優勢。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #3
programme.desc: 我們跟隨奧克蘭動物園的鳥類團隊進入科羅曼德山脈的荒野,他們協助拯救本土鷸鴕的數量。這是袋獾的獵食潮,大象團隊面臨至今為止最大的挑戰。

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've got monkey criminals, magic and mirrors, cheeky monkeys, monkey pals, banana loving primates, baby monkeys, monkeys vs cameras, monkeys out on the town, and monkeys acting like us humans

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: What items should a novice cat owner prepare to welcome their cat home? Recommendation of the best breeds for beginners among all cute cats! Eat like a champion cat by following healthy recipes we reveal! Don’t be afraid if you have a destructive cat at home, a trainer will help you understand your cat’s out-of-control behavior, Angelic Cat Training Class has begin! When the owner goes on a trip, felines will have a great vacation at the cat hotel!

programme.desc: 奧斯卡金像獎得主麥迪文再次飾演前由中情局訓練的殺手積遜龐,並在這部充滿懸念的動作驚悚片中展開逃亡龐患上失憶症後,把充滿暴力的過去拋諸腦後,與女朋友瑪莉過著正常的生活可是,經過一次僥倖避過刺殺後,他安然過活的計劃隨即破滅如今,龐被不明敵人追殺,他證明了自己並非輕易能解決的目標,而他的技術,決心和韌性也不容小覷叛諜追擊2-機密圈套情節跌宕起伏,緊張刺激,更配有精彩的汽車追逐場面,是近年來最機智兼使人屏息的動作驚悚片之一

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #9
programme.desc: 兔耳山深信只要打贏梅宮,獲得防風鈴與自由,就能變得比誰都要「快樂」。他乘勢持續攻擊梅宮,卻沒有對他造成絲毫傷害。無法理解梅宮所說的「你的拳頭太弱,因為沒有背負任何東西」的兔耳山,在受到梅宮全力一擊後,浮現腦海的是開懷大笑的獅子頭連成員們。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #10
programme.desc: 面對認輸而打算交出獅子頭連的兔耳山,梅宮不僅說出「從今天起我們就是朋友啦」,甚至還開起了慶功宴,現場氣氛讓人無法想像剛才兩方的鬥爭。櫻雖然感到混亂,但也因此與表達懺悔之意的十龜及兔耳山成功交談。如此種種讓櫻心中對「頂點」的看法產生了變化。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #12
programme.desc: 即將開戰之際,拉格納聽完絲塔莉亞保護同伴的覺悟後,找到了自己在這場戰鬥的目標,並帶著全新的決心將銀氣注入劍中。絲塔莉亞則因初次目睹拉格納壓倒性的力量,體認到自己仍不夠成熟,發誓要讓自己繼續成長。在各方決意交錯中,一決生死的戰鬥揭開了序幕。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #13
programme.desc: 各地戰況越演越烈之下,銀裝兵團憑著絲塔莉亞壓倒性的領袖魅力,克服了奧魯特佐拉的卑劣攻擊,並主動攻入森林。另一方面,拉格納與達拉迪克多拉展開一場激戰,連周圍地貌都遭到改變。拉格納因無法如願擊敗敵人而感到焦躁,為了儘早分出勝負而使出全力一擊。

programme.desc: 兔耳山深信只要打贏梅宮,獲得防風鈴與自由,就能變得比誰都要「快樂」。他乘勢持續攻擊梅宮,卻沒有對他造成絲毫傷害。無法理解梅宮所說的「你的拳頭太弱,因為沒有背負任何東西」的兔耳山,在受到梅宮全力一擊後,浮現腦海的是開懷大笑的獅子頭連成員們。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #10
programme.desc: 面對認輸而打算交出獅子頭連的兔耳山,梅宮不僅說出「從今天起我們就是朋友啦」,甚至還開起了慶功宴,現場氣氛讓人無法想像剛才兩方的鬥爭。櫻雖然感到混亂,但也因此與表達懺悔之意的十龜及兔耳山成功交談。如此種種讓櫻心中對「頂點」的看法產生了變化。

programme.title: 排球少年!! 第一季 #15

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #3
programme.desc: 蘇萊塔被迫再次進行決鬥。為了防止風靈被處理掉,並避免米奧莉奈遭退學,蘇萊塔和米奧莉奈締結合作關係。另一方面,對於對戰敵手的古爾而言,這也是絕對不能輸的一場決鬥。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #11
programme.desc: 結束與獅子頭連的紛爭後,櫻、榆井及蘇枋受到班上熱烈歡迎。相較於圍著三人詢問詳情的同學們,在教室一角,手拿乳清蛋白專注於健身的柘浦大河及戴著耳機專心打遊戲的桐生三輝,看起來格外不同。當櫻等人被柘浦帶進什錦燒店「肌力」時,桐生也帶著女孩進來。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #14
programme.desc: 銀裝兵團被奧魯特佐拉的策略逐漸逼入絕境,釋放出來的大量成龍毫不留情地奪去團員們的生命。與陷入苦戰的艾薩克共同行動的緋紅,試圖以催眠平民參戰打開局面。然而,在森林戰役中為銀裝兵團提供攻防支援的絲塔莉亞,其實已在不知不覺中消耗大量的力量。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #15
programme.desc: 拉格納激發出更多未來自己的力量,壓制了龍族。重傷的絲塔莉亞也不屈地起身了。銀裝兵團被她的鬥志所鼓舞,展現出驚人的韌性。此外,緋紅在檯面下準備的計策也逐漸奏效,就連歷經無數次生死關頭的奧魯特佐拉,神色也開始焦慮了起來。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #5
programme.desc: 自從魔力強大的侍女蜜菈莉絲被列為奧斯卡的新娘候選人後,緹娜夏便專注於解析奧斯卡身上的詛咒。但當緹娜夏得知蜜菈莉絲的出身有可疑之處,便與亞爾斯一起前往試探蜜菈莉絲。奧斯卡卻因此誤會兩人的關係,進而在他的父親凱文國王面前宣告自己非緹娜夏不娶。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #6
programme.desc: 緹娜夏終於成功解開奧斯卡身上的詛咒。當城內正為國王生日慶典準備時,傳來庫斯克爾襲擊他國的報告。這個消息讓緹娜夏陷入沉思,隨後將自己馭使的龍那克託付給奧斯卡。慶典當日,察覺到異常的緹娜夏與奧斯卡告別後,與她因緣匪淺的拉納克出現在奧斯卡面前。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #7
programme.desc: 拉納克將四大國聯合軍視為敵人,企圖支配整個大陸。奧斯卡在塔伊利國碰上暗中來與魯斯托王子交涉的緹娜夏,得知她正竭盡所能降低戰況所造成的損害。拉納克邀請奧斯卡等人前來已滅亡的鐸洱達爾國大聖堂遺址,打算使用緹娜夏的魔力,完成監控大陸全境的術式。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第1季) #8
programme.desc: 打敗拉納克後,奧斯卡為了視察而與緹娜夏一同前往位於國境的米內達堡壘。附近的村莊遭受騎馬民族「伊圖」的殺戮與掠奪,因此喪夫的村長夫人愛爾澤也投靠於此。當「伊圖」首領哈維前來搶奪愛爾澤時,奧斯卡雖在決鬥中獲勝,卻與緹娜夏捲進了突發的異變中。

programme.title: 海賊王 #1
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:鶼鰈情深 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 專題講座:張路加牧師宣教培靈系列
programme.desc: 華人福音工作是現今最大的禾場,我們需要怎樣的裝備,將福音的種子帶到華人當中?就讓擁有豐富牧會經驗的張路加牧師,教大家好好裝備,在福音的道路上奔跑吧。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽

programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 最危險人物
programme.desc: 「一代賊王」葉繼歡今晨於瑪麗醫院羈留病房因癌症病逝,終年55歲。 這個曾經手持AK47在街上亂槍掃射、令人聞風喪膽的賊王在被捕、越獄後再犯案。一次偷渡回港時,中槍被捕,成為半身癱瘓的囚犯。 葉繼歡於2004年歸信耶穌,2010年更親筆回信給《天使心》。 今天,小編在整理葉繼歡的書信時,發現了這一句話

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《快樂的家庭》。

高朋滿座#27粵
programme.desc: 樓上「租霸」徐師奶殺入高家，原來有義收起了徐師奶的拖鞋。徐師奶在夜間遷出該址，留下寫滿詛咒的紙條。溢滿所編的詛咒發生在眾人身上，只得有朋及高麗「身免」。有朋查出全因眾人壞習慣，恐佈繡花鞋竟又再出現。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#38粵普PG
programme.desc: 徐令宜偽裝成黑衣人欲救十一娘，被靖遠候的人窮追不捨，幸得衛國公及彥行相助脫險，但十一娘已行刑在即…原來令宜已把證據呈交給皇上，靖遠候被判死罪，彥行則要流放塞外。仙綾閣名揚海外，十一娘被封一品誥命夫人。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 過年前趕緊辦年貨，主持們前往海味店，一探揀選花膠、鮑魚的學問，煲湯、燜煮各有好選擇！阿譚為氹鼎爺出手炮製賀年佳餚「花膠金蠔燜花菇」，不惜「豪購」優質花膠。除了事前浸焗花膠有竅門，燜煮花菇、金蠔、花膠的次序亦要講究。不少人愛吃豆苗，但阿譚吃得嘴刁，對更加幼嫩的豆胚情有獨鍾！烹調「雞油豆胚」期間，鼎爺竟勾起年少傷心事？眼見拍檔未盡興，鼎爺再奉上一道「冬瓜寶盒」。清甜的冬瓜夾住鹹香的金華火腿，可謂絕配！

programme.title: 匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 不少人長期受鼻敏感(過敏性鼻炎)困擾，有何常見誘發主因？控制情況或需用上類固醇；坊間的「通鼻藥」卻不宜連續使用逾七天？耳鼻喉科醫生還會概述正確的洗鼻方法。起床後踏地的第一步感到劇烈疼痛？可能是患上足底筋膜炎，脊醫細說主要症狀，如不處理或會影響走路姿勢，繼而導致全身疼痛。衝擊波是其中一個治療方法，箇中原理如何？「睇餸食飯」，Margaret師傅帶來「瑞典肉丸」，烹調重點在於多香果與肉荳蔻兩種香料？

programme.title: 健康必殺食粵
programme.desc: 有人無辣不歡，也有人極之怕辣，究竟吃辣對健康可有益處？辣椒含有辣椒素，具抗氧化、抗炎功效，吃籽更可攝取多種營養素。六號與黃婧靈、衍峰和江嘉敏比拼「大話椒」遊戲，要憑對家反應猜出吃辣之人！湛錦鈿教大家自製辣椒醬，還以三色椒焗製芝士中東米。芥末有助抗菌、促進消化，與壽司絕配，婧靈竟挑戰山葵原條吃？薑也是辛辣界代表，有散寒解表、止嘔止咳作用。林凱恩會合嘉敏、婧靈，隨陳國強學煮三薑爆雞球與胡椒芥菜排骨煲。

programme.title: 陪著你走#20粵

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 雙手打着拍子，跟隨體適能教練的指令做動作，輕鬆訓練四肢協調度，馬上「WORKOUT 2GETHER」！拍完手臂，輪到大腿和腳跟，熟習後可增加難度，挑戰自己。雙手開合的同時，做踢腿或交叉跳，也考驗平衡力。接着以水樽做鍛練，有助提升全身肌力。試試規律地搖動水樽，形成「水龍捲」；蹲下，把水樽向下丟，能讓水樽立在地上嗎？再往斜上方舉高手，試試將水樽從手掌滾向肩膊。過程中難免會掉下水樽，但持續練習總可成功。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 第一學期最後一天，學生會告知陽葵，她們對陽葵的栽培宣告結束，前提是必須通過最終測試，而題目是做出比偶像公主大賽奪冠時更驚艷的演唱會。陽葵獲准與美月、阿紡三人一起接受測試，三人便開始為測試費煞思量……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵

programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 觀眾發現海防道的百年石牆竟被釘上廣告，質疑此舉有違保育原則；專家細說石牆背後的歷史價值。金價持續上升，吸引不少人投入黃金買賣圖利。然而，有騙徒藉此設立騙局，並遊說投資者。據悉受害人遍佈兩岸三地及東南亞，單在香港就有逾四十人受騙，涉款金額逾二千萬！事主述說被騙經過，經濟學者則就事件發表看法。本地寵物展開鑼，展場除了琳瑯滿目的寵物用品外，也設特別打卡位。另會帶來可改善過敏狀況的健康資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2734粵
programme.desc: 因家人催逼，細曹總要於立春前找到合適的對象，也令他沒心情洽談生意，不肯與家聰簽約。家聰為了討好細曹總，遂答應為他物色對象，並找到一個符合其要求的理想人選。細曹總跟這人本來甚是投緣，詎料……另一方面，細曹總意外被困，幸得某人相救，過程中發現此人並不簡單，因此認定她是其「真命天女」。此人的身分出乎家聰意料，家聰不想她重蹈覆轍，成為細曹總的「受害者」，於是為了幫她而付出一番努力……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#9粵PG
programme.desc: 遠程、映朱否認與英拔之死有關，英拔的頭骨上卻發現帶有映朱DNA之物。頌星驚訝龐喆獲保釋，龐喆或會阻撓其子包家勉成為醫美集團的行政總裁。映朱指證龐喆是殺人及走私古董的主謀，龐喆再次被捕，他卻早有部署。希仁等查出拍賣行的非法勾當，古董商志健竟參與其中！志健供出英拔慘死的經過；頌星卻向希仁提出質疑……趙舟要希仁暫緩釋放龐喆，更重提他與頌星的舊事。希仁憶及亡兄，借酒澆愁……馨儀設局引出真兇，與其對質……

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 沈家經營飯館，惟生意不佳，便決定把祖宗的故事拍成影片以作宣傳。眾人換上古裝到祖屋兼網紅景點雲水苑拍攝，卻還缺一個壯男飾演祖宗林晏；看見路上有合適的人選，韶光便追上去；經過大門後，卻發現自己已身處古代…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 嘉欣想蒸魚宴客又要有新意，肥媽放進陳皮、欖角滿足其要求。阿媽更貼心分享洗魚的妙招，讓怕腥的客人也能安心享用。邵師傅將薑蔥蟹煮出新高度，加入自製鹹魚醬，令花蟹更添鹹香。嘉欣為了口福忍不住叫「老竇」，所為何事？用鴨煮花膠並非常見做法，鼎爺卻憑深厚中菜經驗，將兩者共冶一爐，煮出鹹香滋味，箇中有甚麼技巧？德哥竟選用臘腸炮製甜品！他將芋頭、番薯炸香後用糖煨煮，再配炸臘腸品嚐，入口帶有豬油甘香。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵

programme.title: 名媛望族#33粵
programme.desc: 木水說認罪為保護小由，她卻與啟燊雙宿雙棲，對他不公平，要求小由與他返廣州，二人發生關係。啟燊想起木水說出小由父親名字，懷疑小由已知彼此父親的轇轕。木水叫小由帶小茹與他離開香港，小由堅持要回鍾家交代。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#38粵普PG

阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 只需加入適量豉油，即可令簡單菜式鮮味倍增。鼎爺、阿譚到訪醬油廠，發掘優質豉油的製作竅門。一道「玫瑰豉油雞」最能體現豉油的真味。為光雞「注水」的簡單步驟，已見鼎爺細密的烹調心思，要品嚐最佳風味竟不宜「趁熱」？緊接登場的「京蔥蝦籽刺參」，用料矜貴，鼎爺還施展刀工為佳餚「錦上添花」。鼎爺及後以麥芽糖和芝麻為合桃變妝，帶來新春小吃「琥珀合桃」，而秘訣在於「一氣呵成」！主持們另會介紹珠豆、黑金剛等花生品種。

programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 痔瘡其實是先天組織，隨年紀變腫才出現症狀，並分類為內痔、外痔與混合痔，症狀有何不同？外科醫生細說診斷流程，及透過調整生活的改善方法。效果未如理想就要用藥或施手術，治療或會引起甚麼後遺症？伴侶於熱戀期或會形影不離，相處久了卻會有所改變，可有方法維持熱戀期的激情？家庭心理治療師提供「愛情保鮮法」建議，原來從不爭吵亦非絕對理想！愛情長跑最大的敵人又是甚麼？「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「越式燒雞肉法包」。

programme.title: 身體最誠實粵
programme.desc: 手震是患病警號？莫樹錦醫生指手震可分為生理、原發與病理性，成因可以很簡單。為進一步了解，他約來腦科專家莫仲棠醫生訪談。補充多巴胺是治療柏金遜症主流？發噩夢或是腦退化先兆？嘉賓還述說藥物新發展。四張視網膜圖像就可兩分鐘內測出阿茲海默症風險？眼科學者介紹如何使用人工智能系統，評估患阿茲海默症的可能性。另外，多使用手機有機會引致腕管綜合症，物理治療師帶來小測試。哪類人士較易牙肉萎縮？原來選對牙刷好重要！

programme.title: 單戀雙城#1粵PG

programme.desc: 小丸子想知道自己會說什麼夢話，於是聽從爺爺建議，嘗試用錄音機錄下自己的夢話。小丸子化身日本童話《漏雨老宅》中的小狼女，與一眾動物齊心協力調查濱治爺爺所說的最可怕事���是什麼東西。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: Tiffany姐姐對冰屋充滿興趣，繪畫導師特意在這次「Artspiration」示範如何畫出。先畫一條彎彎曲曲的線，加上一條弧線，隨後於弧線內畫可愛人像，便能營造出在冰屋居住的感覺。「開心SHARE」題目是「我最想達到的目標」， Emily姐姐分享兒時如何為實現當上跳舞老師的夢想而奮鬥，有投稿女生亦立下相似目標。另有小朋友朝向成為花式跳繩港隊成員的目標而努力練習，其訓練片段展示熟練技巧，令人讚嘆。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 暑假到來，陽葵在夢中遇見美人魚大賽造型，她向陽葵賦予了一個試煉——陽葵三人要穿上她，就必先找出秘寶「人魚星塵」。陽葵跟家人來到美月的別墅度假，得知美月也做了同樣的夢，繼而找上阿紡，在海邊找尋人魚星塵。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 康城一個兩房新盤，業主希望在原有開則上，盡量增加收納，具體可以怎做？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
匠心築未來粵
programme.desc: 星級藝員阮浩棕親身前往工地，向建造業不同工種的師傅、專才請教及學習，了解燒焊、釘板、紮鐵、混凝土、批盪、油漆、玻璃幕牆、工程監督，各個崗位的工作日常，以及如何善用新科技輔助並完善工序，讓觀眾感受行內專業盡責的匠心、匠技、匠魂與匠行精神。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2735粵
programme.desc: 瑞素、璟風經過某後巷，發現有餐廳在那裡棄置廚餘，引來不少老鼠，瑞素更因此受驚。二人嘗試循不同途徑解決該餐廳的衛生問題，卻毫無成效。另一方面，城安以特別的「洗腦營銷手法」向璟風等人借錢，最終令璟風借錢給他。璟風受城安啟發，想到對付該餐廳的方法，並成功利用網絡「潮文」引起眾人對該餐廳衛生問題的關注……其後，仿傚璟風的「廣告文」蔚然成風。此時，璟風打算再以相同手法對付不法狂徒，詎料……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#10粵PG
programme.desc: 真兇道出英拔遇害真相，欲對馨儀下手……龐喆要阻止家勉出任醫美集團行政總裁，頌星設法制止；龐喆使計陷害子廉得逞，欲接掌新酒店。公孫珀修讀法學專業證書課程，與范小禹等組成溫習小組。頌星擔任課程講師，宣佈考試最高分者可成為其徒弟。公孫珀發現同學之中，有嗑藥、「請槍」代做功課等問題。網上考試當天發生不少狀況，包括小禹遲到、視像鏡頭一度失靈，姚舒琴更突然昏倒！公孫珀懷疑舒琴昏倒另有隱情。頌星公佈考試成績……

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 林晏假裝喝醉，韶光把手伸進林晏衣衫尋找雲水苑的鑰匙，被林晏一把抓住，沈家被帶回去審問。沈家不肯透露他們有何目的，林晏準備殺掉一人，韶光急中生智，表示自己是林晏的未婚妻，並說出了林晏的真實身分…

programme.title: 聚大金鳳呈獻:在家宴客60道菜粵
programme.desc: 西冷牛配韓式辣醬與阿根廷青醬，酸辣新風味。積奇帶來烤焗牛肉的時間掌控秘訣，還提到出爐放涼後切開，可避免肉汁流失。鼎爺奉上中式開胃菜「酸甜脆炸鱔球」，並耐心指導嘉欣切雙飛鱔片。要炸出微酥不硬效果，裹上蛋白是竅門？急凍大蝦以胡椒、蒜蓉爆炒鮮爽口感，嘉欣用手品嚐份外滋味，更憶起獲某人剝蝦殼已甚感動，卻被肥媽笑言易呃！平平無奇的蔬菜如何煮出驚喜？星哥選用雞樅菌、鮮腐竹與四色椰菜花，巧製色彩繽紛的健康料理。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
名媛望族#34粵PG
programme.desc: 懿芳駕車幾乎撞車，木水驅車至海邊，兩人幾乎擁吻起來，木水及時推開懿芳。子君與百鏘見卓萬與丹丹親密，百鏘重提與她合作推倒卓萬山。子君向心蘭表示卓萬不曾珍惜她們，她要卓萬知道他有多錯，心蘭欲阻卻無能為力。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 痔瘡其實是先天組織，隨年紀變腫才出現症狀，並分類為內痔、外痔與混合痔，症狀有何不同？外科醫生細說診斷流程，及透過調整生活的改善方法。效果未如理想就要用藥或施手術，治療或會引起甚麼後遺症？伴侶於熱戀期或會形影不離，相處久了卻會有所改變，可有方法維持熱戀期的激情？家庭心理治療師提供「愛情保鮮法」建議，原來從不爭吵亦非絕對理想！愛情長跑最大的敵人又是甚麼？「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「越式燒雞肉法包」。

programme.title: 身體最誠實粵
programme.desc: 手震是患病警號？莫樹錦醫生指手震可分為生理、原發與病理性，成因可以很簡單。為進一步了解，他約來腦科專家莫仲棠醫生訪談。補充多巴胺是治療柏金遜症主流？發噩夢或是腦退化先兆？嘉賓還述說藥物新發展。四張視網膜圖像就可兩分鐘內測出阿茲海默症風險？眼科學者介紹如何使用人工智能系統，評估患阿茲海默症的可能性。另外，多使用手機有機會引致腕管綜合症，物理治療師帶來小測試。哪類人士較易牙肉萎縮？原來選對牙刷好重要！

programme.title: 單戀雙城#1粵PG
programme.desc: 陳總要求開辦馬來西亞豪華團，式適往走一趟。地陪人員陸恭梓遲了接送式適，酒店負責人麥貫天拒絕接見她。展博認識尼斯酒店太子女劉音，令式適可向貫天介紹計劃。展博與式適吃飯時，突然有一女子從後擁著展博及吻他。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#28粵
programme.desc: 「高雅山房」即將舉行結業音樂會。溢滿對由才女關鈴鈴所愛情小說情有獨鍾，美娜要悅滿介紹與溢滿相親，眾人趁機質問溢滿對愛情的看法，溢滿大爆他與才女關鈴鈴在幼年時的初戀故事，有情相信埋藏在溢滿心底的秘密。

programme.title: 天龍八部#1粵普PG
programme.desc: 喬峯送消息到少林寺，與慕容復切磋勝出。段譽得罪無量劍派，被鍾靈搭救。段譽勸神農幫別向無量劍尋仇，閃電貂咬傷眾人，幫主挾持鍾靈要段譽取解藥，途中段譽被無量劍弟子追趕，摔下懸崖，汪劍通讓喬峯繼任丐幫幫主。

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 秋冬是欣賞蘆葦的好時機！嘉賓林穎彤由鹿頸出發，途經紅樹林抵達谷埔，見識壯麗的蘆葦花海；同場加映白鷺生態，如幸運還能遇見「秋冬限定」的蒼鷺。行山過後，主持們到訪主打爐端燒的日式餐廳，品嚐時令海鮮和蔬菜。士多啤梨既美味又有營養，還可入饌中和食材的油膩感。眾人走進有機農莊，即摘即吃士多啤梨，再向廚房型男請教士多啤梨菜式的烹調竅門。秋冬型格帽子，戴上保暖之餘，也可突顯個人風格；三位年輕「潮人」有何推介？

programme.title: 季節限定 秋冬粵
programme.desc: 薑黃擁有豐富藥用價值之餘，還有抗氧化作用！主持們下田挖掘薑黃，試製薑黃醬及鮮榨甘蔗薑黃汁。他們又順道摘取數款冬天當造蔬菜烹調菜式，搭配薑黃飯一起品嚐。秋冬服裝以深色為主調，如何利用配飾造型增強時尚味道？時裝設計師帶來飾物配襯小貼士。冬天容易手腳冰冷，更可能影響睡眠質素。今集推介蒸腳療程，藉着促進血液循環，改善怕冷問題。除了試吃多款新式煲仔飯暖胃，主持還請教湯水達人製作補氣益胃的「冬菇椰子烏雞湯」。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿拉伯的傳統手工刺繡—塔利，由多條線, 不斷重複地編織，用以裝飾阿聯酋的傳統服裝，讓阿拉伯人在重要場合上穿上。塔利是塑造阿聯酋女性身分認同並傳承多元口述文化的種子。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普PG
programme.desc: 香港芝麻灣島與世隔絕,有間戒癮學校,住著需要戒掉不同癮症的年輕人 也有特殊教育需求，情緒偏差的學生。菲律賓南部的海上巴瑤族兒童,因貧困無法就學,幸有熱心人辦海上學校,讓他們有機會念書，不必街頭行乞。

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 圖爾庫是芬蘭最古老的城市，有度假村保留了舊有的木屋建築，讓人猶如住進歷史博物館。芷珮還獲老闆帶路，見識當年禁酒期間的藏酒洞穴；及後體驗傳統煙燻桑拿，感覺好原始！地標教堂吸引眾多新人舉行婚禮，只因「夠長」？從住屋、飲食感受風土人情，芷珮探訪當地人的海邊大宅，還會前往美食廣場「開餐」。監獄如何搖身一變成為商、住兩用的特色景點？旅程最後一站，芷珮下榻隱藏於赫爾辛基森林的酒店小屋，望着夕陽跟觀眾說再見。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 距離中、上環商業區不遠的半山，可發現截然不同的悠閒氣氛。周奕瑋、朱凱婷、朱智賢化身「藝」文青，結伴玩盡區內至「CHILL」蒲點。走進老字號懷舊茶樓，回味60年代「一盅兩件」；再到訪唐樓臨立的永利街，尋找即將逝去的歲月回憶。一個沒有華麗裝潢的街邊排檔，何以討得食家蔡瀾歡心？新潮美食同樣多姿多采，三人一口氣吃盡日、韓「潮食」。香濃咖啡與單車運動結成好友？昔日警察宿舍如何變身創意文化集中地？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主凱文以進電影院卻看到「爛片」與吃自助餐為例子，讓大家更易理解何謂「沉沒成本效應」。人們在日常生活中，不少情況都受此影響，如交往已有一段時間的情侶即使性格不合，仍不願分手，正是沉沒成本效應的體現。谷主們繼而討論甚麼文化會加劇沉沒成本效應，凱婷、瀅仴分別提出三分鐘熱度與不可浪費，詳情如何？三人亦思考可怎樣於日常生活避免此效應，凱文提到曾決定狠心離開一位相識六年的朋友，並脫離被對方PUA的日子。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 禽畜肝臟入饌有助補血，三閨密有口福了！用梳打粉洗豬潤，雖可去腥，但會令肉質變硬，原來用砂糖效果更佳？中菜講鑊氣，保哥爆炒三杯豬潤炒出火，笑言小兒科！豬潤、蜆、啤酒煮意粉配搭新穎，帶出意想不到的西式滋味。煮焦糖要有心機，煎鴨肝也有竅門，留意家嘉、志恒示範「煎法式鴨肝伴焦糖蘋果」。青瓜夾滷水鵝肝同吃，巧妙中和油膩感；保哥以牛油紙代替鍋蓋封面浸煮鵝肝，有何作用？嚳儀另送上花膠、蜜瓜靚湯，滋補又甜蜜！

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 配合豆腐主題，家嘉以豆腐做餡料包製意大利雲吞；保哥自薦幫忙，還提出繽紛煮意。接着眾人齊齊動手，包出的雲吞更是形狀各有特色。保哥把豆腐炸脆扮薯條，效果如何？翠如、詩雅、自瑤幫手把炸豆腐與味粉拌勻，期間誰人獲讚有型漂亮？保哥巧製「雪菜毛豆凍豆腐」，凍豆腐有助吸收醬汁，原理如何？家嘉烹調甘筍濃湯，並放入炸脆的豆腐粒，造出多層次口感。嚳儀另奉上消暑「西瓜脆脆西米杯」，她與志恒會為這款甜品配上甚麼歌韻？

programme.title: 全城一叮粵PG
programme.desc: 本輪對戰參賽者目標一致，只求為觀眾送上歡樂！繆家慶以結他輕鬆彈唱自己的「前半生」，還出招討四位主持、嘉賓歡心。孟希璘、彭翔翎、黃凱琪將魔術元素注入「野人故事」，竟令伍姑娘笑到標眼水，傑少卻要嚴肅點評……壓軸對壘再掀高潮，招浩明挑戰危險的吞火棒魔術，並邀盈盈客串助手，表演凌空移枱奇技。對手孖八將「坐廁」搬上舞台，展示神級創意舞蹈，還玩除褲、濕身，究竟去到幾盡？賽果揭盅，神秘嘉賓到場嘉許「總台主」！

programme.title: 聲級學堂粵
programme.desc: 導師們解構動畫配音，示範用聲音擬人化，為卡通角色賦予靈魂。學員聲演「狐假虎威」動畫片段，學配音還要學懂解讀成語。另試配《神鵰俠侶》、《西遊記》等古裝動畫，表現如何？無對白的角色，足以考起配音員嗓子、語調技巧。二十強學員分成十組進行聲演考試，輪流為動畫、古裝及人氣劇集配音，排頭位考核的兩學員，緊張得險些不能完成。有學員未了解對白意思，毫不入戲，讓眾考官大失所望！也有學員對稿時欠默契，發揮強差人意……

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 順利克服期中試的考驗後，男子韻律體操隊又迎來新的變故。高三的女川竟遇上交通意外，腿部受傷而無法練習。為了讓女川儘早康復，翔太郎等人照顧他無微不至，然而，女川似乎有著無法說出口的秘密…

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 協調能力欠奉？試試跟着這集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」做運動，透過簡單的手勢與肢體動作，就可提升協調能力，同時訓練全身肌力。雙手不斷向前轉動的動作看似容易，但再加上踏步與轉向等指令，雙手不免會感到疲倦。鋪好瑜伽墊，迎接一系列「下肢肌力訓練」。側躺後，單腳屈曲向上踢、伸直向上踢和伸直轉圈；轉坐下姿勢，伸直雙手並帶動上身轉向，還可順道強化核心肌力。「動物好萌友」介紹隨時可斷尾逃生的肥尾守宮。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子希望早一步享受春天，於是聽從中野的建議，去河津町看在冬天綻放的河津櫻。媽媽為大家買了新恤衫，但爸爸更愛熟悉的舊恤衫。爺爺在外不慎摔倒，但想到自己穿著殘舊內褲，堅決拒絕就醫。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
programme.desc: 根據政府統計處數字，本港零售業銷貨價值指數由2024年3月起，連續14個月按年下跌，不過去年5月至11月就連續7個月錄得上升，零售業是否已經復蘇？近年內地網購平台強勢攻港，補貼推出「一件包郵到港」服務，市民消費習慣亦逐漸轉變，有店舖指實體店很難打「價格戰」，業界面對甚麼危機？消費者網購比例越來越大，零售業要如何轉型滿足消費者需求？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 京東呈獻：愛心改造家粵
programme.desc: 獨居可能是自由，但同時要自行面對家中的所有難題。Carol因腦癱而要坐輪椅，面對的困難可能更多，包括公屋家中光線不足、晾衣、從高櫃取物等。宅Sir到訪後，建議用單人床替代上下格床，讓陽光可映照入屋。雄心壯志改造家居的首天，他竟接到須保留上下格的消息，怎樣應對？貼心添置智能家電，能方便做到「一站式遙控」，用電腦、看電視、晾衣都變得容易。求職中的Carol卻擔憂要多付電費，宅Sir亦為她帶來實際提議？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！自稱於歌唱App屢獲S級的幼稚園老師、要向囡囡展示實力的駐場歌手，分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: CY陳宗澤與小肥合唱<至少做一件離譜的事，皆因小肥覺得宗澤的新歌<急口令是私訊作曲人得來，這舉動太離譜？小肥亦會帶來<Make Yourself At Home。女團Honey Punch跳唱<滑到入心，唱法參考K-Pop甚麼細節？胡子貝演繹劇集歌<不枉，為粵語咬字下了不少苦功。吳若希新歌<超前告別請得Supper Moment創作與編曲，以發掘自己更多面向，同時要提醒在世者？

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 自古以來，人類為了果腹不辭勞苦。尼泊爾人甚至冒險攀上高峰懸崖，收集珍貴的天然蜂蜜，再配麵包享用，香甜可口。而貴州人善用甘蔗提取蔗糖，這更是一項與時間競賽的工藝。揚州人習慣以甜食開展每一天，因此當地師傅製作點心時，糖不可或缺。翡翠燒賣、千層油糕皆因加入糖才會更添滋味。土耳其的果仁蜜餅則是國民級代表甜點，製作過程絕不簡單，其中熬煮糖漿更是關鍵步驟，令這道甜點口感酥脆香甜，成為在地民眾引以為傲的美食。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 滑浪風翼青年港隊收穫亞青金牌與世青銅牌，眾小將分享感受，並以世界盃香港站為下個目標。短道速滑港將郭子峰、林靜欣將出戰米蘭冬奧，兩人暢談首次征奧心情與備戰情況。NBL香港金牛初登啟德舞台，於主場球迷打氣下勇挫對手；還帶來金牛在荃灣的另一場激鬥。帆船環島賽在港舉行，主持一探盛況，並體驗雙人帆船的快感。賽車消息，區天駿與團隊奪杜拜耐力賽組別冠軍，許建德則為征戰澳洲做準備。另送上季前田徑測試賽的短跑戰報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 本地樓價止跌回升，在預期減息的環境下，今年樓市的走向會如何？AI和醫療科技是近年最熱門的消費電子產品主題，科技公司如何迎合這個發展潮流？

programme.title: 有個閨密叫祖藍粵
programme.desc: 有請「閨密同學會」主角，一對兒時好友祖藍與容祖兒！再進校園班房，細看黑板貼出兩人的同班班相，暢談學生時代的印記。排排坐上課小測，祖藍重看當年的漫畫功課，即席來趟聲演交流並延續畫作。小息時間，兩位同學仔驚見書包收藏久違了的港式零食！祖藍還公開祖兒的「曖昧名單」，接着組成小學合唱團唱出<我的驕傲，默契依然。體育科，小學雞們要做出一系列難度動作；當播放師友深情視像影片，祖藍、祖兒再也按捺不住情緒……

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 溜走的真味粵
programme.desc: 瀨尿蝦、生蠔、蟹等海鮮，加入鹽、醋、辣椒等調味料醃製，即成潮汕民眾的日常鮮味。主持們與嘉賓陳煒一同品嚐生醃盛宴，除了膏蟹、瀨尿蝦之外，更有難得一遇的生醃龍蝦。四人來到南澳的海邊捉海膽，德哥示範即開海膽，配上三姐的生醃汁，又是一道鮮味美食。南澳港水質優良，近岸選購地道的水產後，三姐在海中心開火，炮製生醃生蠔、蝦醬魷魚與響螺紫菜湯飯，煒哥還會客串擔任助廚。眾人在夕陽餘暉下享用佳餚，零舍寫意！

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 距離中、上環商業區不遠的半山，可發現截然不同的悠閒氣氛。周奕瑋、朱凱婷、朱智賢化身「藝」文青，結伴玩盡區內至「CHILL」蒲點。走進老字號懷舊茶樓，回味60年代「一盅兩件」；再到訪唐樓臨立的永利街，尋找即將逝去的歲月回憶。一個沒有華麗裝潢的街邊排檔，何以討得食家蔡瀾歡心？新潮美食同樣多姿多采，三人一口氣吃盡日、韓「潮食」。香濃咖啡與單車運動結成好友？昔日警察宿舍如何變身創意文化集中地？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 谷主凱文以進電影院卻看到「爛片」與吃自助餐為例子，讓大家更易理解何謂「沉沒成本效應」。人們在日常生活中，不少情況都受此影響，如交往已有一段時間的情侶即使性格不合，仍不願分手，正是沉沒成本效應的體現。谷主們繼而討論甚麼文化會加劇沉沒成本效應，凱婷、瀅仴分別提出三分鐘熱度與不可浪費，詳情如何？三人亦思考可怎樣於日常生活避免此效應，凱文提到曾決定狠心離開一位相識六年的朋友，並脫離被對方PUA的日子。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 阿拉伯的傳統手工刺繡—塔利，由多條線, 不斷重複地編織，用以裝飾阿聯酋的傳統服裝，讓阿拉伯人在重要場合上穿上。塔利是塑造阿聯酋女性身分認同並傳承多元口述文化的種子。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普PG
programme.desc: 香港芝麻灣島與世隔絕,有間戒癮學校,住著需要戒掉不同癮症的年輕人 也有特殊教育需求，情緒偏差的學生。菲律賓南部的海上巴瑤族兒童,因貧困無法就學,幸有熱心人辦海上學校,讓他們有機會念書，不必街頭行乞。

programme.title: 歡唱小浣熊
programme.desc: 七隻頑皮小浣熊在神奇音樂盒開啟歡樂冒險！每集獻上趣味充滿想像力的歌曲，讓孩子快樂學習！透過語言遊戲激發創意、豐富詞彙！快來加入這場音樂與知識的奇妙盛宴吧！

programme.desc: 關於友誼、成長，關於正義戰勝邪惡的故事。高中生麥斯的父親意外死亡，他搬回老家，找尋父親的過去，卻意外獲得超能力與一個飛行機器人，經由訓練後麥斯逐漸掌握這股力量，穿上盔甲發揮潛在力量變成鋼鐵戰士，以對抗威脅世界的神秘力量。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 依法相愛吧
programme.desc: 【李昇基×李世榮二次合作，青梅竹馬譜出律政羅曼史！！】改編自人氣網路小說，「怪物天才檢察官」金正浩與「韓國小姐出身律師」金琉璃，青梅竹馬重逢後，一起經營「LawCafé」的故事。既是律師事務所、又是咖啡館的小天地裡，用溫暖的飲品與犀利的法律智慧，幫助無數人伸張正義。從法庭到日常，辯論化為鬥嘴，正義化為浪漫，療癒又甜蜜的愛情由此展開。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 森林偵探

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Sam the Snowplough clears the streets
programme.desc: Lilly and Tom are stuck in the snow! Troy selects the most perfect truck for the job: Sam the Snowplough!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called "Five Poison Web", spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: In this period martial arts thriller, three police graduates are assigned to a town rife with crimes and corruption. They vow to uphold justice but are hampered by their corrupt superior, resulting in them putting their lives and the lives of their beloved in danger.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Clans of Intrigue
programme.desc: Heroic outlaw Chu Liu Xiang is dining with his friend Monk Wu Hua, when Gong from the Holy Water Palace appears and accuses Chu of stealing the holy water from her Palace and using it for various murders. Chu denies, and is given a month to find the murderer or be killed by Gong. To prove his innocence, Chu decides to investigate the case...

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor student Lin is engaged to the daughter of a rich man who despises him because of his family's declining status. Lin visits his fiancee before leaving for the Imperial examination, but finds a maid lying dead in blood. As Lin's bloody handprint is left on the site, he is accused of the murder. How can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: A compulsive gambler with bad luck owes money to a violent gangster boss and trades his wife as down payment, causing her to leave him. As he decides to kill himself, a mysterious old man offers him a proposal to marry the ghost of his dead daughter in exchange for cash and an expensive apartment.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hung's relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhou's favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Heads For Sale

In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters &amp; recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: Young swordsman Lung Fei encounters strange omens portending the death of his fiance. His enquiries with the help of Chief Constable Tieh Hu reveal an astounding story, in this tale of men and women struggling to save their true loves.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Heaven in the Dark
programme.desc: Michelle files for sexual harassment charges against Pastor To after they shared a passionate kiss, and this turns into a bitter court case. The pastor turns away from his faith thereafter, while Michelle becomes even more religious. When they meet again 5 years later, both of them realize that they have still not gotten over the incident.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: In Cycle
programme.desc: A seemingly happy couple who loves diving come to a deserted island for a diving vacation, which is part of the husband’s plan to murder his wife. His conspiracy however, is intervened by a series of bizarre events on the island. Can the couple eventually escape from the enigmatic ocean?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.desc: Bubble goes on an adventure with Firefly. They go to Gargamel's hovel to steal Rowena's tooth. Gargamel has created a switch that can turn off all the lights so that he can find the Smurf village. Only Firefly can free her friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs S4 - The Thirteenth Dessert Slithering Smurfs
programme.desc: There's one dessert missing to keep with tradition! Chef and Blossom head to Gargamel's to steal it ... but he's celebrating Christmas with his family. Bubble and Jokey are the worst babysitters! They've turned Baby Smurf into a snail.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Alpaca Lies Rocket Plan
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne and Bobby have to deal with an old friend of Arturo's-Al the Alpaca, but Al has it out for the kids. Abuelo helps CJ build a rocket, but when things aren't going well, Abuelo tells a little fib to preserve CJ's feelings.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - The Odd Father Long Shot
programme.desc: Carlos has to choose Carlitos' Padrino in time for his Christening, but will he make the right call? Carlota needs a PE credit in order to graduate, so she and Ronnie Anne set out to find the right sport for her.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Sad, Single, and Stranded A Waste of a Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Will &amp; Min show Jack around to help him find a good story. Lily spills boba in Jack's suitcase and tries to hide the evidence. Jack tries to find "the big picture" as Lily shows him how to spend a perfect summer day in Canyon Valley.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Woori World Finding FlamingoFan85
programme.desc: The family prepares for war, AKA a trip to the local Asian market. After their battle to procure a rare cookie, Jack feels more part of the family. The Groom &amp; Board gets a bad review. Lily tries to find the culprit and "correct the record.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Pablum Plankton MuseBob ModelPants
programme.desc: Plankton wins a "cutest baby" contest and becomes the face of a baby food brand. When Squidward's one-off portrait of SpongeBob takes the art world by storm, he has no choice but to produce more.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Delivery of Doom My Father the Boat
programme.desc: SpongeBob is challenged by E.V.I.L. to make a delivery to their secret lair in 10 minutes or less. When Mr. Krabs gets trapped inside of Pearl's new boat, he must pretend to be its engine to avoid being caught.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Dad's Stache Stash A Root Galoot
programme.desc: Cecil shows Patrick his mustache collection. The Star family brings a mandrake root into their home.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - The Starry Awards Biorpsgiving
programme.desc: Patrick hosts an award ceremony. Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks S5 - Alvin Gets Schooled My Life As a Dog
programme.desc: When Dave learns Alvin blamed him for his poor grades to Miss Smith, Dave sets down a very strict study schedule. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidently shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is dog sitting.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks S5 - Mr. Lou Love Song
programme.desc: Mr. Lou: Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked! Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found. Since Simon wrote the poem he panics his secret will come out.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Arr in the Family Finders Weepers
programme.desc: Ronnie Anne is determined to help CJ get onstage at a Pirate Dinner Show. Ronnie and Sid have to decide whether they "borrow" money from a lost coin purse they found in the mercado.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Stress Test How to Train Your Carl
programme.desc: The family tries to help Bobby get over his test taking anxieties. Carl gets lost in the city zoo after sneaking away from his family, in search of Keyon, the Komodo dragon.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 - Bummer School
programme.desc: Chloe, Jinx, and Booch are designing a new school mascot, but Max and Phoebe's fighting ruins the project. After Chloe expresses her anger toward her siblings, they realize their twin-fighting impacts Chloe in new ways now that they're guardians.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover S1 - The Parent Zap
programme.desc: After Phoebe and Max let Chloe's friends watch a horror movie and eat candy, Jinx and Booch's parents want to meet Chloe's. With Hank and Barb away, Max and Phoebe transform into them to help Chloe. It goes well until the real Hank and Barb show up.

programme.title: Danger Force S1 - Earth To Bose
programme.desc: Strange things start to happen to Bose when he finds himself in love with an alien.

programme.title: Danger Force S2 - Bottle Snatchers
programme.desc: After Danger Force thwarts a robbery at Club Soda and has a legendary night celebrating their win, Ray challenges the kids to repeat their epic night out without their superhero uniforms and powers.

programme.title: Henry Danger S5 - Whistlin' Susie
programme.desc: After accidentally activating an atomic bomb in the Man Cave, Ray and Henry decide to drive it out into the Swellview desert in order to save their city.

programme.title: Henry Danger S4 - Toddler Invasion
programme.desc: When The Toddler takes control of the Man Cave, Charlotte and Jasper have to find a way to sneak into the Man Cave and free Kid Danger and Captain Man.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Raph VS. Water
programme.desc: The Turtles and Mutanimals are caught in the Storm of the Century! But when a new group of SEA MUTANTS threaten the city... Raph will be forced to use his WORDS to save the day.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Mikey Takes Charge
programme.desc: Mikey and Genghis Frog are sent into the storm on a supply run to the local market when they encounter the electrifying LEE THE EEL! Now Mikey has to step up and be a LEADER!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - What's Love Gato Do With It? Dial M. For Mustard
programme.desc: After a magician hypnotizes Bobby into thinking he's a cat, the family needs to snap him out of it! Ronnie Anne and her friends uncover a town mystery: what happened to Bruno's hot dog cart?

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - The Kid Plays in the Picture Achy Breaky Art
programme.desc: Carl's love for toys gets him caught up in a whirlwind toy review career. Frida's art gets a bad review, the kids try to stage a new auction to lift her spirits.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Tooth and Consequences
programme.desc: When Adelaide loses a tooth, Carl and Bobby teach her about El Raton, the Latin American "tooth fairy."

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - The Boba-Get Be Your Own Bean
programme.desc: Lil's favorite boba shop is closing! The kids try to save the cafe using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker. Lil and Min both realize how similar they are to their moms and set out to distinguish themselves.

programme.title: Wylde Pak S1 - Meats of Strength Dead Ed's
programme.desc: Jack's new friend Beef invites him to a sleepover. Jack, a sleepover newb, freaks out over impressing his new friend. Jack &amp; Lil try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive restaurant Dead Ed's.
